raw_segments.text: Numbers, it is. All music when you come to think. Two multiplied by two divided by half
is twice one. Vibrations, chords, those are. One plus two plus six is seven. Do anything
you like with figures juggling. Always find out this equal to that. Symmetry under a cemetery
wall. He doesn't see my morning. Callous, all for his own gut. Musimathematics. And
you think you're listening to the ethereal. But suppose you said it like, Martha, seven
times nine minus X is 35,000. Fall quite flat. It's on account of the sounds it is.
